display.purpose: Page h1, one per view; balanced wrap.

headline.purpose: License title on the blue plate.

title.purpose: Work names in the Works list.

body.purpose: All running text; tabular figures on by default.

lede.purpose: Intro paragraph under h1, ink-soft, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase h2 section heads and table headers.

money.purpose: Every currency value; display face because Atkinson's zero is slashed.

total.purpose: Quote and license totals under a 3px ink rule.

stamp.purpose: Pink plate state word: UNPAID, PAYING, HELD, ACTIVE, DECLINED, VOID.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Input focus only. The system is otherwise shadowless.

shadows.name: overprint
shadows.purpose: Pink plate over blue plate; depth by ink, not light.

motion.name: ease-ink
motion.purpose: Only for the plates moving between registration states (1.15s).

motion.name: register
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: off -> in on verified PayPal capture; in -> drift on refund.

motion.name: stamp-wipe
motion.purpose: New stamp word wipes in left to right after the plates land.

motion.name: line-in
motion.purpose: Fresh quote terms and new history rows.

motion.name: cite-in
motion.purpose: Clause citations arrive from the shoulder.

motion.name: replay-delay
motion.purpose: License activated within 90s renders off-register then snaps in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation/transition durations .01ms, delays 0; no fresh cascade; no replay; static reading bar

breakpoints.name: split-collapse
breakpoints.note: max-width; aside drops below column as a 360px-proof two-column grid

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: max-width; rail becomes sticky top bar, shoulder 0, tables reflow, fixed pay bar

narrative.overview:
A license is a two-ink riso print on uncoated stock. While it is unpaid, its blue and pink plates sit visibly out of register; a signature-verified PayPal capture pulls them into register. That one physical metaphor carries the product's central claim (the payment is the license) and every other surface stays quiet so the proof can say it.

The rest of the app is a printed ledger, not a dashboard: an off-white paper ground with a faint fibre tooth, black ink rules instead of cards, a solid riso-blue rail, and terms set as ruled lines with their rate-card clause sitting in a shoulder margin. Colour is spent by job, not decoration: blue for anything you can press, pink for the single live state, yellow only as a highlighter on the brand's own words.
keyCharacteristics: Two spot inks plus black on paper; overprint via `mix-blend-mode: multiply`.
Ruled lines (2px heavy head rule, 1.5px row rule) instead of cards, shadows, or fills.
A shoulder margin (220px) beside every priced line holds its clause citation.
Exactly one authored motion: the plates moving into register.
State is printed in words on a run sheet, never as coloured badges.

rules.name: The One Live Ink Rule
rules.body: Pink marks only what is happening now, plus the logo's second impression. Every pink mark on a screen must describe the same live state (the proof's pink plate, the `now` band and the live dot agree).

rules.name: The No Red Rule
rules.body: There is no error red. Errors are bold ink with a 3px ink rule above; refusals are struck through in ink; revocation is struck through. The palette has no colour outside the two inks, yellow and black.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Full yellow is applied only to the brand's own words and to selection, as a highlighter band. Its wash additionally marks things the reader must notice (the notice block, the "offline reader" tag). Never decoration.

rules.name: The Unslashed Zero Rule
rules.body: Money is always set in the display face (700, tabular + lining figures, no tracking, no wrap). Atkinson's zero is slashed and reads as struck-through next to refused lines.

rules.name: The Struck Line Rule
rules.body: A line-through means refused, not granted, or revoked; nothing else in the system uses strikethrough.

rules.name: The Ink Not Light Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from overprint and register, never from cast light. No shadows, no glass, no gradients except highlighter bands and the halftone.

dos: Do use riso blue for every pressable thing and nothing decorative.
Do keep fluorescent pink to the live state (pink plate, `now` band, live dot, in-flight table state) and the logo's offset impression.
Do set every money value in Bricolage Grotesque, 700, tabular and lining figures.
Do separate content with ink rules (2px head, 1.5px rows) and put each term's clause in the 220px shoulder.
Do say state in words on the ruled run sheet, and mirror it on the proof's register.
Do keep the move into register the only authored motion; everything else is a short ease-out arrival.
donts: Don't use status badges or coloured pills for license state; state is text, a blue check, a pink band, or a strike.
Don't introduce red or any off-palette colour for errors, danger or refusal; use bold ink, ink rules and strikethrough.
Don't set money in Atkinson Hyperlegible; its slashed zero reads as struck.
Don't wrap content in white cards with shadows; the ground is paper and structure is ruled.
Don't use yellow for anything except the brand's own words, selection, notices and the offline tag.
Don't animate the plates for decoration or on hover; they move only when PayPal changes the license state.
